This is modeled as a probabilistic function P(y|x) = softmax(w^T x + b), where w and b are learned parameters. The classifier's dual nature lies in its ability to both predict immediate defensive action and infer underlying strategic intent. Failure modes include misclassification due to ambiguous screen setups or insufficient training data for rare schemes. The operator's breakdown regime occurs when defensive behavior diverges from historical norms, e.g., emergence of hybrid strategies.
